analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 36.1 entering oversold territory, MACD histogram showing improvement. However, 5 consecutive down days and a 2.26x volume surge over the 5-day average suggest a capitulation within a downtrend. ADX at 25.6 indicates an intact trend, but -DI remains above +DI, signaling persistent selling pressure. The price of $471.51, down 27.6% from its 52-week high, sits 79.9% above the 52-week low of $260.44. Falling below the SMA200 at $475.97 confirms a bearish phase.
